appended_absolute_tolerances.basis: Two temperatures of order 700 K fixed by the closure's root solve (native termination 1e-8 MW on the duty; the oracle's Brent root differs by about 3e-10 K) are subtracted to a margin that can be arbitrarily small near the bound, so a relative rule cannot pass it; 1e-6 K is a verification tolerance on a calculated temperature margin only, never permission to accept a physical constraint violation (the verdict is re-derived exactly from the operands). Declared after execution of study 20260926-design-study-parameters on the owner's ruling G-001 of 2026-09-26 (work/orchestration/goals/design-study-parameters/evidence/owner-ruling-g001.md), the one refusal being 5.3e-10 K absolute on a 0.363 K margin.

ir.label: I-R, the re-selected inventory (WI-093 case inputs; the manifest baseline)

sensitivities.anchor_rule: Sensitivities run at the anchors on the I-R grid: the starting point; the best passing point (the highest oracle-scanned net among I-R grid points with every check satisfied); that point's ratio-step-lower neighbour and flow-step-higher neighbour on the grid (contract § 10); plus the declared extra anchors below. Coinciding anchors collapse to one case. The anchors are chosen from the oracle scan before any native point runs and recorded in axis-plan.json; the native run then confirms or corrects the reading.

extra_anchors.label: screen-best-passing
extra_anchors.why: the contract's named best passing point from the 54-point screen at the design flow (contract § 5, § 8 a): kept as an anchor so the sensitivities cover the operating claim's neighbourhood near 2,500 kg/s; the r1 scan found the refined grid's best passing point at 2,250 kg/s / 1.5183, whose flow-step-higher neighbour is the starting point itself, which left three distinct anchors (preparation-r1/).

science_qualification: A flow x stage-ratio sweep at fixed machine efficiencies on a costed assembly of reviewed definitions; the passing region is bounded by engineering checks, not qualified as a design; the auxiliary register, pump law, rest-of-plant constant and fuel convention are declared assumptions tested at anchors; no off-design map, hydraulic model, blanket-inlet requirement or cost-side check exists; no optimum is interpolated.
